title: Tailscale WhoIs as sole auth primitive — correct, no tokens to steal
description: The architecture uses the Tailscale-verified TCP peer address as the only authentication signal, with no sessions, JWTs, or API keys. A contributor might suggest adding an API key or HMAC for 'defense in depth,' but this would introduce a second credential that must be stored, rotated, and protected — a larger attack surface, not a smaller one. WhoIs is sufficient because Tailscale guarantees the address and the address proves identity.
